question: Which of the following rivers of India drains into the Bay of Bengal?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Godavari**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Godavari or Dakshin Ganga is one of the east flowing rivers in India which originates from the western ghats near Trimbakeshwar, Nashik district in Maharashtra.**
 
• It flows through Maharashtra, Chhattisgarh, Telangana, Odisha and Andhra Pradesh.
 
• **It forms a delta in Andhra Pradesh and finally drains into the Bay of Bengal. Hence option 2 is correct.**
 
• Nizam sagar project, Kaleshwaram project are the major projects that are built up on the Godavari river.
 
• The other east flowing rivers are Krishna, Cauvery, Mahanadi etc.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Tapi** is one of the major west flowing rivers that originates in Satpura range in Betul district, Madhya Pradesh.
 
• **It flows through Madhya Pradesh, Maharashtra, Gujarat and drains into the Gulf of Cambay in the Arabian Sea.**
 
• **Narmada river is a west flowing river that originates at Amarkantak range in the Madhya Pradesh.**
 
• It flows through Madhya Pradesh, Maharashtra and Gujarat and **drains into the Gulf of Cambay in the Arabian Sea.**
 
• **Mahi river originates in Dhar district in Madhya Pradesh** and flows through Madhya Pradesh, Rajasthan and Gujarat and finally **drains into the Gulf of Khambhat in the Arabian Sea.**
